concept.title: Turning ON Highway Lane Change Assist

p.uicontrol: Press OK button to enable Lane Change Assist

conbody.p: Highway Lane Change Assist is ready to operate when the function is ON and the following conditions are satisfied:

li.p: Your vehicle is ON and detects another vehicle behind more it than once.
Your speed is above 30 km/h (20 mph).
When driving 30-80 km/h (20-50 mph), your vehicle recognizes other vehicles in the left and right adjacent lanes, and there is no risk of collision when changing lanes.
The instrument cluster does not display the hands-off warning.
While the Lane Change Assist function is ON, Lane Following Assist will not cancel, even if the turn signal indicator or hazard lights are operating.
Lane Change Assist automatically turns OFF when you drive in the following conditions:
Roads lack physical center separations structures, such as guardrails.
A pedestrian or cyclist is on the road ahead.
If you drive below 25 km/h (15 mph) when Lane Change Assist is ready to operate, the function’s status changes to standby.
If you drive 30-60 km/h (20-40 mph) and your vehicle does not detect other vehicles in the right or left adjacent lanes, the Lane Change Assist status changes to standby.
The Lane Change Assist status changes to standby if a risk of collision is detected.
The images or colors may display differently depending on the specifications of the instrument cluster or theme.

note.p: When Highway Lane Change Assist turns OFF, Steering Assist is temporarily canceled. Always be cautious when driving.
